## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle commentary on [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* by the early-Qīng monk [智素](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E7%B4%A0) (Zhìsù), accompanied by the structural outline [KR6n0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0048) *kē*. The "*yīnxiǎng bǔyí*" 音響補遺 ("phonetic-and-resonance supplement") title indicates that the work specifically supplements the late-Míng commentaries (especially Zhìxù's [KR6n0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0047) *guānxīn fǎyào*) with phonetic glosses and additional doctrinal-resonance material that those commentaries had passed over. Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X51n0826).

**Abstract**

The *yīnxiǎng bǔyí* extends the late-Míng Yogācāra revival into the Qīng period. Where the late-Míng commentaries focused on doctrinal-systematic exposition, Zhìsù's work pays significant attention to philological detail — pronunciation, archaic vocabulary, and obscure technical terms — that the late-Míng commentators had treated only in passing. This makes the *bǔyí* a useful complementary reference text for any study of T1585 in conjunction with the late-Míng commentaries.

The dating bracket adopted (1644–1750) covers the early-to-mid Qīng. The work is preserved only in the *Xuzangjing* and not in the principal Qīng-period canonical editions.
